runtime_note: In ChatGPT, Clara works with the files and connected sources available in this conversation and clearly marks any local step she cannot run here. In Codex, Clara can execute the full local workflow and create durable, reviewable files in your workspace.

skills.attribute-reporting: Attach the retailer product dataset and any existing reviewed attribute mapping. Clara maps products to the category taxonomy, preserves the agreed recent-versus-rest or best-seller-versus-other comparison, and returns the attribute findings, exceptions, and a reviewable report.
skills.brand-fit: Provide the completed, checked Retailer Signals analysis, evidence of the brand's current presence at that retailer, and the brand-owned catalogue. Clara compares all three, separates current-presence gaps from catalogue opportunities, and returns an evidence-linked Brand Fit assessment for review.
skills.claim-basis-map: Attach the deck, its source materials, and the generation-time claim snapshot if one exists. Clara links each slide claim to a source, calculation, reasoning, or unsupported status and returns a readable claims map plus any text drift that requires refresh.
skills.deck-correction: Attach the current PPTX or Clara HTML deck and the transcript, notes, recording, or comments containing the requested changes. Clara translates the feedback into an evidence-linked change ledger, protects untouched content, and returns a revised-copy plan and verification findings; when editing tools are available, she applies and checks the changes on a copy.
skills.html-deck: Provide the source documents or data, intended audience, and decision the presentation must support. Clara develops a source-bound storyline and slide plan, keeps claims and numbers traceable, and returns a reviewable standalone HTML deck when file tools are available.
skills.interview: Describe the research objective, participant role, language, and either the approved campaign or a scoped one-off brief. Clara prepares the interview brief; when hosted interview tools are available, she creates the expiring participant link and returns the completed evidence bundle with its quality review.
skills.privacy-surface-review: Identify the Clara workflow or hosted service being added or changed and provide the relevant source files. Clara inventories model-readable data, external boundaries, accounts, retention and controls, then returns the updated privacy record and validation findings for release review.
skills.reporting-engine: Attach the CSV, Excel, or Parquet dataset and state the business question or decision it should support. Clara profiles the fields, separates candidate metrics, dimensions and periods from reviewed meanings, checks chart compatibility, and returns a source-backed semantic and reporting plan with ambiguities clearly marked.
skills.transcribe: Provide the recording—or say that you want to start a voice capture—and identify the target case or folder and any known speakers. Clara selects the capture or import path; when Hosted Voice is available, she produces the transcript, supports speaker attribution, and returns a reviewed evidence package with uncertainties kept separate from advice.
